messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 6.1.1

6.1.1. Mechanical strength The carrier, including any trapdoors, shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to offer the space and strength corresponding to the maximum number of persons permitted on the carrier and the maximum working load. The working coefficients for components set out in sections 4.1.2.4 and 4.1.2.5 are inadequate for machinery or related products intended for the lifting of persons and shall, as a general rule, be doubled. Machinery or related products intended for lifting persons or persons and goods shall be fitted with a suspension or supporting system for the carrier designed and constructed in such a way as to ensure an adequate overall level of safety and to prevent the risk of the carrier falling. If ropes or chains are used to suspend the carrier, as a general rule, at least two independent ropes or chains are required, each with its own anchorage.

response.text:
The carrier, including any trapdoors | shallOfferSpaceAndStrength | space and strength corresponding to the maximum number of persons and the maximum working load | | "designed and constructed in such a way as to offer the space and strength corresponding to the maximum number of persons permitted on the carrier and the maximum working load"
Working coefficients in sections 4.1.2.4 and 4.1.2.5 | areInadequateFor | machinery or related products intended for lifting persons | | "are inadequate for machinery or related products intended for the lifting of persons"
Working coefficients for components in sections 4.1.2.4 and 4.1.2.5 | shallBeDoubled | machinery or related products intended for lifting persons | as a general rule | "shall, as a general rule, be doubled"
Machinery or related products intended for lifting persons or persons and goods | shallBeFittedWith | a suspension or supporting system for the carrier | | "shall be fitted with a suspension or supporting system for the carrier"
Suspension or supporting system | shallPreventRiskOf | the carrier falling | | "to prevent the risk of the carrier falling"
Suspension or supporting system | shallEnsure | an adequate overall level of safety | | "designed and constructed in such a way as to ensure an adequate overall level of safety"
Carrier suspended by ropes or chains | shallUseAtLeast | two independent ropes or chains | as a general rule; only if ropes or chains are used to suspend the carrier | "at least two independent ropes or chains are required"
Each rope or chain used to suspend the carrier | shallHave | its own anchorage | as a general rule; only if ropes or chains are used to suspend the carrier | "each with its own anchorage"
